problem: Size requests for two owned games returned ownership_unavailable and the frontend described that failure as missing size data.
changes: Ignore zero app/depot placeholders without granting any entitlement.
Retrieve missing package access tokens through PICS before package metadata queries.
Keep complete package coverage and reject malformed identifiers; retain distinct failure reasons.
Preserve prior display estimates when a transient plan response has no size; failed verification cannot enable installation.
Distinguish license metadata, timeout, depot access and platform failures in the installation page.
limits: Successful size plans do not establish real CDN download, install completion or game compatibility.
Missing/partial metadata for other titles remains explicitly unavailable; estimates are not exact peak disk use.
The changes address license metadata interpretation; no entitlement or purchase check is bypassed.
